# AI Foundation Services (T-Systems)

> Sovereign, GDPR-compliant LLM inference API. OpenAI-compatible. Hosted in Germany and the EU. 30+ open-source and proprietary models on a single endpoint.

## Get started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/): Install the OpenAI SDK and send your first request.
- [Choosing a model](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/getting-started/choosing-a-model): Recommendations as of 2 November 2026. T-Cloud first.
- [Authentication](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/getting-started/authentication): API keys and bearer-token requests.
- [Shared vs dedicated](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/getting-started/shared-vs-dedicated): Shared rate plans versus Dedicated LLM Serving.
- [Concepts and glossary](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/getting-started/concepts): Tokens, TPM, RPM, context window, T-Cloud, partner models.
- [Migrate to the New API](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/api-transition): Phased move from the existing endpoint to the New API.

## Models

- [Catalog](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/models): Hosted LLMs, embeddings, vision, audio, and image models.
- GLM 5.3 (`GLM-5.3`) on T-Cloud, in the shared rate plans, from 2 November 2026. Input €1.40 / output €4.40 per 1M tokens.
- DeepSeek 4.1 Flash (`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`) is in the preview catalog from 2 November 2026, with pricing to be announced.
- [Preview models](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/models/preview): OCR and decision models are free on any active plan; DeepSeek 4.1 Flash pricing is to be announced.
- [Deprecations](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/models/deprecations): Upcoming retirements and models already retired.

## Guides

- [Chat completions](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/chat-completions): OpenAI-compatible chat API.
- [Streaming](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/streaming): Token-by-token responses via Server-Sent Events.
- [Vision](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/multimodal): Image input on the chat API.
- [Multimodal](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/modalities): Where image, audio, image output, and OCR are documented.
- [Embeddings](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/embeddings): Text embeddings for semantic search and RAG.
- [OCR](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/ocr): Document parsing with the preview OCR models.
- [Function calling](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/function-calling): Tool definitions and JSON arguments.
- [Structured outputs](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/structured-outputs): JSON Schema on the Responses API.
- [RAG](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/rag): T-Cloud embeddings plus a T-Cloud chat model.
- [Reliability and retries](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/reliability): Retry 429, 500, and 503, or queue the request.
- [Migrate from OpenAI](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/migrate-from-openai): Point an OpenAI SDK at this API and use a catalog model id.
- [Decisions](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/guides/decisions): Typed decisions for agent steps.

## API reference

- [Endpoints](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/reference/api-endpoints): REST API reference.
- [Error codes](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/reference/error-codes): HTTP error codes with causes and resolutions.

## Plans

- [Plans and pricing](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/plans): Essential, Professional, Agentic, and Enterprise.
- [Rate limits](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/reference/rate-limits): Per-plan request and token limits.
- [Dedicated serving](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/plans/dedicated): Reserved GPU hardware.

## Integrations

- [LangChain](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/integrations/langchain): Use langchain-openai against AI Foundation Services.
- [LlamaIndex](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/integrations/llama-index): Point the OpenAI-compatible client at AI Foundation Services.

## Optional

- [FAQ](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/faq): Compliance, pricing, rate limits, ordering.
- [Changelog](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/changelog): Product changes.
- [German docs](https://docs.llmhub.t-systems.net/de/): Full documentation in German.
- [SmartChat docs](https://docs.smartchat.ai.t-systems.net): Separate product documentation.
